data.one_liner: Abstraction layer for Dart isolates with inter-isolate communication and plugin support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to spawn isolates and automatically establish a communication channel. Isolates can call Flutter plugins via a background view, enabling plugin usage from background threads.
use_when: Need to run CPU‑intensive Dart code off the main thread
Want to call Flutter plugins from an isolate without manual channel setup
Require named isolates for easy reference and cleanup
avoid_when: Tasks that spend most time in native plugin code (no performance gain)
Applications that already use custom isolate solutions or need fine‑grained control over ports
strengths: Named isolates for convenient lookup and disposal
weaknesses: No performance benefit when calling native plugins
Relies on flutter_isolate which may add overhead
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_isolate dependency; no build_runner or native permissions required
